errors.error_description: Introduced a latch by not assigning next_valid on the else path of an if in an always_comb; the line beginning the if (effective_en) block lacks a corresponding else that assigns next_valid.
Used case-equality (===) in synthesizable combinational logic for zero detection, which is unsafe for synthesis.
Declared a signal 'ghost' that is never used anywhere in the module.
Used an escaped identifier that is a reserved keyword (\always_comb) as a port name.
